[Intro]
[G]
[D]  [G]  [D]
[G6]I

[Verse 1]
[G]wandered so aimless
life filled with sin
[C]I wouldn't let my dear
[C7]saviour in [G]
Then Jesus came like a
stranger in the night
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Chorus]
[G]I saw the light,
I saw the light
[C]No more darkness
[C7]no more [G]night
Now I'm so happy no
sorrow in sight
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Intrelude]
[D]  [G]  [D]
[G6]

[Verse 2]
[G]Just like a blind man I
wandered along
[C]Worries and fears I
[C7]claimed for my [G]own
Then like the blind man that
God gave back his sight
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Chorus]
[G]I saw the light,
I saw the light
[C]No more darkness
[C7]no more [G]night
Now I'm so happy no
sorrow in sight
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Solo]
[G]
[C]
[C7]  [G]
[D]  [G]

[Verse 3]
[G]I was a fool to
wander and a stray
[C]Straight is the gate and
[C7]narrow the [G]way
Now I have traded the
wrong for the right
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Chorus]
[G]I saw the light,
I saw the light
[C]No more darkness
[C7]no more [G]night
Now I'm so happy no
sorrow in sight
Praise the Lord
[D]I saw the [G]light.

[Outro]
[D]  [G]  [D]
[G6]
title: I Saw the Light
tuning: E A D G B E
